QuestInfo.name: Dehydrated Tree Branches
QuestInfo.0: When you asked Winston about the dried-out plants in Perion, he stopped and thought about it quite seriously. Maybe this is more complicated than you thought. See if there's something you can do to help.
QuestInfo.1: Dr. #p1022006# found something suspicious in the #m102000000# area, which might be causing the dehydration. He wanted to find out more, so he asked you to bring him #b20 Dehydrated Tree Branches#k.\r\nTip: You can get them from Stump monsters, such as Ghost Stumps.
QuestInfo.2: You brought the Dehydrated Tree Branches to Dr. #p1022006#. Hopefully, Dr. #p1022006# can come to a conclusion soon...

0.0: This could just be an issue with the weather...but I have a hunch it is something far more evil. Could you check on something for me?

yes.0: Smashing! You're just who we need on this case. #b#t4033059#es#k can be found on #rall Stumps#k. I need #b20 #t4033059#es#k to confirm my suspicions. The Dark Axe Stumps tend to have the most of them.

no.0: What's gotten into you, sport? It wasn't so long ago that you were always eager to help. Now look at you. Shameful!

1.0: I say, do you have those 20 #t4033059#es I asked for?

yes.0: Excellent! Give me a few moments to examine these, and I should have some answers.

item.0: How goes the collecting? Close to #b20 #t4033059#es#k, I assume? Chin up, friend. You'll get there.
